Sugar Bottom Bikes Wednesday Night Gravel

North Liberty, IA · Gravel

Sugar Bottom Bikes Wednesday Night Gravel is a gravel group ride in North Liberty, IA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:10 pm from Sugar Bottom Bikes.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a, B and C groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @sugar_bottom_bikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sugar Bottom Bikes Wednesday Night Gravel group ride

A weekly gravel ride from the shop with three pace groups. The shop also hosts Tuesday Trails, a casual social ride of the Sugar Bottom mountain bike trails, and winter fat bike rides.
